en: Udāna 8.2 The Second Discourse Connected with Nibbāna Thus have I heard—
At one time the Blessed One was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now on that occasion the Blessed One was instructing, exhorting, inspiring, and gladdening the bhikkhus with a Dhamma talk concerning Nibbāna.
Those bhikkhus, having applied their full attention, gave ear, and listened to the Dhamma with their whole heart.
Then the Blessed One, having understood this matter, on that occasion uttered this inspired exclamation:
“The Uninclined is indeed hard to see;
for truth is not easily seen.”
"For one who knows and sees, craving has been penetrated;
